The thoracic and lymphatic ducts are a pair of lymphatic ducts that together drain the entire lymphatic system into the venous system @ilahiAnatomyThoraxThoracic2026.

# Function

The thoracic duct drains the entire body except for the right side of the head and neck, which is drained by the lymphatic duct @ilahiAnatomyThoraxThoracic2026.

# Anatomy

"Typical" anatomy of the TDuc has high variation and only applies ~50% of the time @ilahiAnatomyThoraxThoracic2026.
